guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (asynchronous reset), idle_q is set to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False
When rst_ni is high and a positive clock edge occurs, idle_q is updated to the value of idle_d

assumptions.claim: idle_d must be a valid multi-bit encoded value of type MuBi4 (one of the defined legal states)
assumptions.cond: always when rst_ni is high and a clock edge occurs
assumptions.risk: idle_q could latch an invalid encoding, causing downstream logic that expects legal MuBi4 values to misinterpret the idle state
